name: field
title: Field
description: Validation-library-agnostic form field primitives — combine labels, controls and help text to compose accessible, groupable form fields.
usageSnippet:
<Field>
  <FieldLabel for="name">Full name</FieldLabel>
  <TextInput id="name" autocomplete="off" placeholder="Evil Rabbit"/>
  <FieldDescription>This appears on invoices and emails.</FieldDescription>
</Field>

props.name: disabled
props.description: Sets `data-disabled`, dimming the label and title.

props.name: invalid
props.description:
Marks the field as invalid. Sets `data-invalid` on the wrapper, which every
descendant part restyles against via `group-data-*` selectors. The matching
`aria-invalid` belongs on the control itself.

accessibilityNotes: `FieldSet` and `FieldLegend` keep related controls grouped for keyboard and assistive-technology users.
`Field` renders `role="group"` so nested controls inherit labeling from `FieldLabel` and `FieldLegend` when combined.
Apply `FieldSeparator` sparingly so screen reader users encounter clear section boundaries.
Set `invalid` on `Field` for the visual error state, and pair it with `aria-invalid` on the control itself — the `invalid` prop alone does not add `aria-invalid`.
Render `FieldError` immediately after the control (or inside `FieldContent`) and reference it from the control's `aria-describedby` so assistive technology announces the error with the field.

examples.title: Default
examples.description: A field pairs a label, control and helper text via matching ids.

examples.title: Invalid
examples.source:
import Field from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/field/field.marko";
import FieldLabel from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/field/field-label.marko";
import FieldError from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/field/field-error.marko";
import TextInput from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/input/input.marko";

<Field class="max-w-sm" invalid>
  <FieldLabel for="field-invalid-username">Username</FieldLabel>
  <TextInput
    id="field-invalid-username"
    value="taken-name"
    aria-invalid="true"
    aria-describedby="field-invalid-username-error"
  />
  <FieldError id="field-invalid-username-error" errors="This username is already taken."/>
</Field>
examples.description: Pass `invalid` to `Field` to switch the whole block into an error state, and `aria-invalid` on the control itself.

examples.title: Multiple errors
examples.source:
import Field from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/field/field.marko";
import FieldLabel from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/field/field-label.marko";
import FieldError from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/field/field-error.marko";
import TextInput from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/input/input.marko";

<Field class="max-w-sm" invalid>
  <FieldLabel for="field-multi-password">Password</FieldLabel>
  <TextInput
    id="field-multi-password"
    type="password"
    value="abc"
    aria-invalid="true"
    aria-describedby="field-multi-password-error"
  />
  <FieldError
    id="field-multi-password-error"
    errors=[
      { message: "Password must be at least 8 characters." },
      { message: "Password must contain a number." },
    ]
  />
</Field>
examples.description: `FieldError` accepts a list of errors and renders them as a bulleted list.

props.name: errors
props.description:
One error, or a list of them. Each entry may be a plain message string or any
object carrying a `message` — the shape of a Standard Schema issue, so output
from valibot, zod or arktype passes through unchanged. Duplicates are removed.

Ignored when body content is provided.
